title.zh: 修订第85号法案，将《省政府法》适用于邦板牙省，并将该省首府从Bacolor迁至San Fernando的法案
title.en: AN ACT AMENDING ACT NUMBERED EIGHTY-FIVE, EXTENDING THE PROVISIONS OF THE PROVINCIAL GOVERNMENT ACT TO THE PROVINCE OF PAMPANGA, BY CHANGING THE CAPITAL OF THAT PROVINCE FROM BACOLOR TO SAN FERNANDO.
title.orig: AN ACT AMENDING ACT NUMBERED EIGHTY-FIVE, EXTENDING THE PROVISIONS OF THE PROVINCIAL GOVERNMENT ACT TO THE PROVINCE OF PAMPANGA, BY CHANGING THE CAPITAL OF THAT PROVINCE FROM BACOLOR TO SAN FERNANDO.
title.vi: Luật sửa đổi Đạo luật số 85, áp dụng Đạo luật Chính quyền tỉnh cho Pampanga và chuyển tỉnh lỵ từ Bacolor đến San Fernando
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแก้ไขกฎหมายเลขที่ 85 ให้นำกฎหมายว่าด้วยรัฐบาลจังหวัดมาใช้กับ Pampanga และย้ายเมืองหลวงจังหวัดจาก Bacolor ไป San Fernando
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Undang-Undang Nomor 85, memberlakukan Undang-Undang Pemerintahan Provinsi di Pampanga dan memindahkan ibu kota provinsi dari Bacolor ke San Fernando
title.ms: Akta meminda Akta No. 85, memperluas pemakaian Akta Kerajaan Wilayah kepada Pampanga dan memindahkan ibu kota wilayah dari Bacolor ke San Fernando

text.en:
Section six of Act Numbered Eighty-five, entitled "An Act extending the provisions of the
Provincial Government Act to the Province of Pampanga," is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Section 6. The capital of the province shall be at the municipality of San Fernando."

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect August fifteenth, nineteen hundred and four.
Enacted, July 22, 1904.
